result.quote: may fire come from Abimelech and consume the leaders of Shechem and Beth-millo, and may fire come from the leaders of Shechem and Beth-millo and consume Abimelech.
result.reason: The key captures the mutual destruction by fire, but it is materially incomplete and imprecise: the curse targets the leaders of Shechem and Beth-millo, not simply Shechem, and Beth-millo is omitted. A complete answer is that fire would come from Abimelech to consume the leaders of Shechem and Beth-millo, and from those leaders to consume Abimelech.
